recentItems.title: కూలీ లేకుండానే పొలం పనులు చేస్తారు | Neyveli village farming tradition Pudukkottai
recentItems.description:
In the small village of Neyveli near Ponnamaravathi in Pudukkottai district, residents have kept a remarkable generational tradition alive where no agricultural laborers are hired and no wages are ever paid. Known locally as 'Maatru Aal,' this unique mutual-aid system brings villagers together to share the workload across every stage of paddy cultivation, from transplanting seedlings to harvesting. Families meticulously record the exact number of days and workers contributed by their neighbors, happily returning the favor when it is time to tend to each other's fields. Watch this inspiring story to see how unity, trust, and shared labor replace money in one of India's most extraordinary farming communities.

recentItems.description:
The newly elected governing bodies of 100 urban local bodies across Andhra Pradesh are set to take charge tomorrow. During the first meeting, directly elected mayors and municipal chairpersons will take their oath of office administered by the District Collector or a designated special officer. Swearing-in ceremonies will be held at municipal council halls and corporation offices across most towns and cities. In Vijayawada, special arrangements have been made at Ambedkar Kala Vedika for the Mayor's oath-taking ceremony. Elections for Deputy Mayors and Municipal Vice-Chairpersons will also take place tomorrow. Watch reporter Kurmaraju's ground report for more details.
